asset: Five-level orbital defense station progression lineup

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: design lineup sheet for a five-level orbital defense station progression in the dark sci-fi strategy game Stellar Syndicates.

OUTPUT AND LAYOUT: a true 3:1 landscape image, preferably 3840 by 1280 pixels. Plain pure white background. Show exactly FIVE separate stations in a SINGLE horizontal row, left to right, each the next upgrade of the same structure. They are NOT five equal-size thumbnails. Use one consistent orthographic scale and exactly the same elevated three-quarter top-down camera, about 40 degrees pitch, for every station. Widths must read approximately 1 : 1.4 : 2.2 : 3 : 6. The fifth station is six times the first station's width and twice the fourth station's width; it dominates the right side. Allocate space accordingly. Every station, including all cannon tips, vanes, fins and rear structures, is fully visible with generous white space between neighboring silhouettes and safe margins. Align the stations as a coherent comparison lineup, with each label centered below its own station. No dividers.

SHARED DESIGN: every level is built around the same hexagonal armored core with a round cyan-lit reactor eye on top. Each upgrade keeps the previous level's architectural form visible at its heart and adds structure around it, like a fortress adding rings of walls. The original core's scale stays constant; newly added structure creates the growth. Weapon hardpoints are heavy turrets on raised armored mounts. The heavy-turret counts below are the TOTAL heavy turrets on each station: do not accidentally retain extra heavy turrets from an earlier upgrade in addition to the specified count.

1. DEFENSE PLATFORM: a compact, low hexagonal gun platform. Exactly ONE heavy twin-barrel turret just forward of the eye, six short radiator fins at the corners, two tiny point-defense nodes.

2. ORBITAL BATTERY: the same core inside a broader chamfered hexagonal armored collar. Exactly TWO turrets on raised barbettes at the two front corners: one a long single-barrel beam emitter with cyan focusing rings, the other a stubby heavy twin mass driver. Small point-defense nodes on the other corners.

3. DEFENSE STATION: the battery architectural form as a hub with exactly THREE armored arms at 120 degrees, each ending in a heavy twin-barrel turret, THREE heavy turrets in total. Between the two rear arms, one open drone hangar with small parked drone craft on launch rails. An empty docking cradle along one arm, sized for a destroyer. Keep the cradle empty: no docked destroyer.

4. CITADEL: the station enclosed by a thick hexagonal armored outer wall with angled buttresses, like a star fort. Exactly FOUR heavy turret bastions on the front and side corners of the wall. Two utility bays on the rear corners: a domed shield generator with brass emitter pylons, and a minelayer with a rack of launch tubes. A tall central command tower; overlapping armored blast-door petals frame the core and leave its round cyan eye recognizable.

5. STAR FORTRESS: a colossal ring fortress, the capstone. A massive armored outer ring joined by exactly SIX thick structural spokes to the citadel architectural form at its hub. Exactly SIX heavy triple-barrel turret batteries spaced around the ring, SIX heavy turret batteries in total. Three utility bays on the ring: a large drone hangar, a shield-generator dome, and a cluster of three tall interdiction-field spires. One enormous spinal SUNLANCE cannon crosses the whole diameter through the hub: a long segmented lance with focusing rings and heat-sink fins. This is one fixed spinal weapon, additional to the six turret batteries. On the far half of the ring, broad overlapping gold heat-shield vanes and solar collector petals (the side that faces its star). It must look far vaster and heavier than any warship. Show the reactor core, citadel hub, six spoke connections and ring as distinguishable nested structural layers.

STYLE: precise colored hard-surface 3D game concept rendering, clean contours, fine panel lines, pale silver titanium armor plates, charcoal gunmetal structure, restrained brass hardware, small cyan lights, mild wear, soft neutral illumination, light from the upper left, no harsh shadows. Each silhouette must read clearly from above at small size. The gold heat-shield vanes on the fifth station are broad functional armored petals, not thin decorative spikes.

No starfield, no star, no planets, no other ships (only the tiny parked drone craft expressly requested at the third station), no weapons fire, no projected beams, no glow halos, no scale bars, no logos, no watermark. No arrows, captions, numbers, headings or other text.

Text exactly once each, small and charcoal, centered under its station, verbatim left to right:
"DEFENSE PLATFORM"
"ORBITAL BATTERY"
"DEFENSE STATION"
"CITADEL"
"STAR FORTRESS"

Edit the supplied orbital defense progression lineup. Preserve the pure white background, exact 3:1 canvas, the five labels exactly as written, all five separate stations in their existing left-to-right order, the orthographic elevated camera, silver/charcoal/brass/cyan materials, fine detail and the overall scale progression. Preserve the first two stations. Make the following precise corrections to the third, fourth and fifth stations. These weapon counts are visually important: every specified turret must be unmistakably visible and separated from the others, with exposed gun barrels.

THIRD STATION, "DEFENSE STATION": rebuild its three-arm layout as a clear Y whose one front arm projects toward the viewer/bottom, and whose two rear arms project toward upper-left and upper-right, exactly 120 degrees apart in the station's plane. Put one clearly visible heavy twin-barrel turret at EACH of the three arm ends: exactly THREE large turrets total. Do not replace any arm-end turret with a utility bay. Tuck a small open drone hangar with tiny parked drones BETWEEN the two rear arms, behind the central cyan reactor. Attach a narrow EMPTY destroyer docking cradle ALONG THE SIDE of one arm, leaving that arm's turret intact. Shorten the arms so the station's total width is about 2.2 times the first station, narrower than the fourth station; retain the original core's size.

FOURTH STATION, "CITADEL": show exactly FOUR heavy turret bastions, all visible: two at the front-left and front-right corners as already shown, PLUS one at the left side corner and one at the right side corner of its thick hexagonal star-fort outer wall. Place the two added turrets outboard on broad raised mounts where the barrels and turret heads are not hidden behind other parts. Retain the rear-left shield dome, rear-right minelayer launch tube rack, tall central command tower, hexagonal armored wall, buttresses and armored core petals.

FIFTH STATION, "STAR FORTRESS": the existing ring visibly has five gun turrets. Add ONE matching heavy TRIPLE-BARREL turret battery at the near-center/bottom section of the ring, between the existing near-left battery and the shield-generator dome. It must be fully visible with three distinct gun barrels, giving exactly SIX heavy triple-barrel batteries around the ring in total. Retain the six spokes, central citadel, the single enormous horizontal spinal Sunlance weapon crossing through the hub, the gold heat-shield petals on the far side, hangar, dome and cluster of three tall interdiction spires. The fixed Sunlance is additional to, and visually distinct from, the six turret batteries. Make its direction readable with a long segmented muzzle and focusing rings at one end. Leave the fortress drone hangar open but empty, without any additional spacecraft.

Keep every full silhouette inside the canvas and keep white separation between stations. Keep the fifth station overwhelmingly biggest, about six times the first station's width and twice the fourth's width. Do not add any other objects, ships, text, light halos, weapon beams or scenery. Labels exactly once each: DEFENSE PLATFORM, ORBITAL BATTERY, DEFENSE STATION, CITADEL, STAR FORTRESS.

Make a very small, localized correction to this finished five-station lineup. Preserve the entire image exactly, including its 3:1 format, white background, all five stations, proportions, positions, lighting, materials, typography, structures and weapons, except for the newest turret on the enormous STAR FORTRESS at the far right.

On the Star Fortress ring, identify the turret at the near-center / six-o'clock position immediately to the LEFT of the large shield dome. Replace ONLY this turret's barrel assembly with exactly THREE long, clearly separated parallel gun barrels, all pointing outward together toward the bottom edge of the image. Mount those three barrels in a single broad armored rotating gun housing. Its rear has no barrels: remove the small backwards-pointing barrels sticking up behind this turret. This is one conventional TRIPLE-BARREL heavy battery, not a two-ended weapon. Make the three front gun tubes distinctly readable with three separate dark circular muzzle openings.

Retain all FIVE of the other Star Fortress turret batteries unchanged, so the ring has SIX heavy batteries in total. Do not add any turret elsewhere. Preserve the huge fixed horizontal spinal cannon, shield dome, three spires, empty drone hangar and gold heat-shield petals. The four smaller stations and the five labels remain unchanged. No extra text or objects.
